title: Exact K5 collision-strata combinatorics and local power-counting map
scientific_question: Enumerate every nontrivial collision partition of the five K5 vertex variables modulo relabeling and determine which strata can be certified by a supplied one-pair local bound versus which require a correlated multi-pair collision estimate.

power_counting.rule: Negative or zero naive margin is UNRESOLVED, never automatically DIVERGENT, because edge singularities and relative coordinates are correlated.

scope_guard: This is exact graph/combinatorial bookkeeping, not a causal-vertex finiteness theorem.
It does not infer a local pair exponent; Iter447 or source analysis must supply p.
UNRESOLVED means the simple independent-coordinate power count is insufficient, not that the stratum diverges.
No D7 terminal classification or Candidate Gravity authorization can follow from this gate alone.
